storage: ResponsePattern.context.origin (JSON-serialisable, travels with the record through IndexedDB and Supabase persistence)

memoryId.meaning: The record this provenance describes. Checked against pattern.id; a mismatch is REJECT.

userId.meaning: Owner. Null only for data migrated in without an owner; such memory is not claimed by anyone and is treated as historical.

originatingConversationId.meaning: Where the information was learned. Never rewritten by a later update.

originatingSessionId.meaning: The runtime session that produced it. Session-scoped memory is refused outside this id.

originatingConversationTitle.meaning: Title at write time, so a later turn can name its origin honestly instead of inventing one.

updatedAt.meaning: When last reinforced/corrected. Advancing this never moves the origin.

scope.meaning: What kind of memory this is, independent of where it sits relative to the current turn (that is computed from conversationId).

sourceType.meaning: How it came to LÉLU. Inferred and agent-reported material is never presented as fact.

confidence.meaning: Writer's confidence that this is true of the user; derived memories below 0.75 are deferred.

persistence.meaning: Whether it is meant to survive the conversation.

retention.meaning: Retention class. Session memory never becomes durable by accident.

legacyRule.classification: scope = historical-conversation (or session for memoryType=conversation), userId = null, conversationId = null, sourceType inferred from memoryType
legacyRule.guarantee: It may be recalled as something previously learned; it can never be described as said in the current conversation, and it is never deleted.

sessionId.why: A restored page must not inherit the previous session's temporary material.

agent_conclusion.note: Retrieved only with RETRIEVE_WITH_CONTEXT and an [inferred] label.

retrievalRelation.other-conversation: both present and different → any authorization is RETRIEVE_WITH_CONTEXT
retrievalRelation.unknown-conversation: current turn has no conversationId → history only, labelled
retrievalRelation.no-conversation: origin has none (legacy/migrated) → history only, labelled
